text: The Patriots are heading into Sunday's matchup against the Raiders significantly short-handed on defense, placing veteran wide receiver Mack Hollins and fullback Reggie Gilliam on injured reserve while promoting safety Brenden Schooler and cornerback Kindle Vildor to the 53-man roster in a flurry of pre-game moves, with the secondary hit particularly hard as starting cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) and Carlton Davis III (neck) are ruled out along with four other players. There's a sliver of good news in the backfield, where running back Rhamondre Stevenson has returned to practice after his own injury concerns, though he'll need to prove his availability heading into Sunday. The timing couldn't be worse for a New England defense facing Kirk Cousins, who has been one of the NFL's early-season revelations, and to add some glamour to what shapes up as a defensive nightmare, the Patriots will honor Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction during halftime while sporting throwback uniforms in what amounts to a ceremonial backdrop to their injury crisis.
